$comment: Human-owned per-component maturity assignments. This file is the single reconciled source of truth for maturityTier; it is NOT generated. Tiers use the vocabulary defined in docs/component-readiness.md: stable | beta | experimental | internal | deprecated. Entries whose `source` begins with 'inferred:' have no documented tier and are pending human review. Entries marked 'reviewed:<date>' were assigned by human review. Entries at the internal tier are intentionally absent from the public barrel. Inference never yields 'stable': only a documented tier can grant unsupervised agent use.

AgentPaymentAuthorization.note: README lists all agentic commerce components as Experimental. docs/agentic-commerce.md marks this family's ScopedSpendControl, ProductFeedReadinessPanel and MachinePaymentMeter as Stable; that table is aspirational and conflicts with the graduation rule in docs/component-readiness.md, which requires the accessible-naming check to pass. docs/agentic-commerce.md currently contains no accessibility guidance. Revisit after Phase 4.
